subject.title: [Bug]: External Control UI tab cannot render gateway-auth plugin route under token auth

question: Should the focused fix use its signed HttpOnly cookie design, align with the broader plugin UI launch/session-token architecture, or defer to that broader work as the single authorization contract?
rationale: Both approaches can solve the 401, but choosing the permanent credential-handoff and plugin-route confinement contract is a security-boundary decision that should not be inferred by automation.

options.title: Align the focused fix
options.body: Use the narrow PR but align its launch-session format and route-root confinement with the broader plugin UI security model before merge.

options.title: Approve the signed cookie
options.body: Land the focused cookie design after dedicated security review and real token/password browser proof, then remove or supersede the overlapping portion of the broader PR.

options.title: Defer to the broader PR
options.body: Keep this issue open against the broader entry-point architecture and close the focused PR if maintainers want only one comprehensive launch-token and iframe-bridge contract.

recommendation.title: Align the focused fix
recommendation.body: Use the narrow PR but align its launch-session format and route-root confinement with the broader plugin UI security model before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent ownership spans authenticated Control UI and Gateway surfaces, making this the best available routing candidate for the cross-boundary design choice.
